verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a watchlist-screening webhook that returns PEP and Sanctions, adverse-media, and ongoing-monitoring results. Pricing lists a PEP & Sanctions check as an add-on to verification, so screening comes from the same vendor and the same webhook/API surface as the verification itself. The Customer Portal covers manual review of verification sessions, but the evidence never shows screening hits being reviewed there. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that screening runs within the same verification session, evidence that watchlist hits appear in the Customer Portal review surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
